name: @vymalo/vpay
//pnpm: JSON has no comments, so the justification for every entry under `pnpm`
lives here. `just audit-web` (pnpm audit --audit-level=high over the whole
workspace, dev dependencies included) is the gate these keep green; every
line below is a case where bumping the direct dependency could NOT clear
the advisory on its own. Dated, because an override that outlives its
advisory is a pin nobody meant to keep — re-check each on the next pass.
overrides['next>postcss'] — 2026-09-03. Four advisories against postcss:
GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q (high, CVE-2026-45623), GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (high,
CVE-2026-73646), GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 (moderate, CVE-2026-41305) and
GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp (moderate, CVE-2026-69153); all fixed in >=8.5.23.
Next pins `postcss: 8.4.31` EXACTLY, and still does on 15.5.25 (the
latest 15.x) and on 16.x — no release of Next unpins it, so there is no
version bump that clears these. 8.4.31 -> 8.5.x is a minor within the
same major, and it is the version `frontends/apps/dashboard` and
`frontends/packages/ui` already resolve for their own `postcss ^8.4.49`
devDependency, so the override dedupes the tree rather than splitting it.
Remove when Next's own pin reaches >=8.5.23.
overrides['@storybook/addon-actions>uuid'] and overrides.vite — REMOVED
2026-09-07 by the exp26 UI revamp (docs/plans/2026-09-07-ui-revamp.md
§1, 'Two pnpm.overrides this change should be able to delete'), measured
rather than assumed: both existed only to clear the Storybook 8 line's
uuid advisory and vite peer mismatch, and the revamp's Storybook 8 -> 10
jump (addon-essentials dissolves; @storybook/react-vite@10.6.0 accepts
vite ^5 || ^6 || ^7 || ^8, which is a superset of vitest 3.2.7's
^5 || ^6 || ^7) removed both constraints these pins existed for.
`pnpm install --lockfile-only` then `just audit-web` confirmed no new
advisory. See docs/plans/exp26-notes/lane-a.md for the measured before
and after.
overrides['@prisma/config>deepmerge-ts'] — 2026-09-04. GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx
(high): DeepmergeTS exhausts the stack on a recursive object graph;
fixed in >=8.0.0. `@prisma/config` pins `deepmerge-ts: 7.1.5` EXACTLY
and so does every Prisma release checked — 6.19.3 (the newest 6.x, the
newest ZenStack 2.22.3 supports) and 7.10.0 alike — so no version bump
of `prisma` clears it. It arrives through `@prisma/client`, which is a
PRODUCTION dependency of `examples/shop`, so it fails the `--prod` half
of `audit-web` as well as the full one. Scoped to the one dependent:
nothing else in the workspace resolves deepmerge-ts, and a bare
override would silently apply to whatever pulls it in next. 8.0.2 is a
major over 7.1.5; `@prisma/config`'s use is the `deepmerge` call on the
loaded config object, unchanged across the major, and it was measured
rather than assumed — `prisma migrate deploy` was run against a real
Postgres from `examples/shop`'s image with this override applied and
applied both migrations. `examples/shop/Dockerfile` installs its
runtime Prisma CLI through a package.json carrying the same override,
so the image does not ship the version this line excludes. Remove when
Prisma's own pin reaches >=8.0.0.
overrides['chevrotain>lodash'], ['@chevrotain/gast>lodash'],
['@chevrotain/cst-dts-gen>lodash'] — 2026-09-04. Three advisories
against lodash 4.17.21: GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc (HIGH — code injection via
`_.template` import key names), GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh and
GHSA-xxjr-mmjv-4gpg (moderate, prototype pollution). All fixed in
>=4.18.0. Every one of the 32 paths pnpm reports runs through
`examples/shop > zenstack > @zenstackhq/language > langium@1.3.1 >
chevrotain@10.4.2`, and each of those three chevrotain packages pins
`lodash: 4.17.21` EXACTLY. zenstack 2.22.3 pins `langium: 1.3.1`
exactly in turn, so there is no bump of a direct dependency that clears
these — the next langium major is a ZenStack release nobody has made.
THREE scoped entries rather than one bare `lodash`, and NOT for the
reason the uuid entry gives — unlike uuid, other packages do resolve
lodash: `@testing-library/jest-dom@6.5.0` (pulled in by
`@storybook/test`) and `chevrotain-allstar@0.1.7` on `^4.17.21`, and
`cypress@15.21.1` on `^4.17.23`. All three float, and today all three
land on the same 4.18.1 of their own accord — `pnpm why -r lodash`
and a single `node_modules/.pnpm/lodash@4.18.1` directory, measured
2026-09-04. That is also what keeps the sentence above about the 32
paths true: delete these three entries, `pnpm install --lockfile-only`,
and the lockfile carries BOTH 4.17.21 and 4.18.1 — 4.17.21 reached only
by `chevrotain`, `@chevrotain/gast` and `@chevrotain/cst-dts-gen`, while
jest-dom, chevrotain-allstar and cypress take 4.18.1 unaided. Measured
2026-09-04 and reverted byte-identically. Scoped anyway, and
deliberately: chevrotain is the only
dependent whose pin is EXACT and therefore the only one an override has
to move, and a bare `lodash` override would freeze those three on
whatever this line says instead of letting them take their own next
patch — including a future one this line has not been updated for.
4.18.1 is a minor over 4.17.21 and the line's own security release;
chevrotain's use of it is grammar analysis, which `zenstack generate`
runs on every install of examples/shop — measured rather than assumed:
`prisma/schema.prisma` regenerates byte for byte with the override
applied. Remove when zenstack ships a langium whose chevrotain is
unpinned or >=11.
packageExtensions['daisyui@4'] — 2026-09-07, added by the exp26 Lane B
review. daisyUI 4's `src/index.d.ts` opens with `import type plugin
from "tailwindcss/plugin"` and its package.json declares NO
`tailwindcss` peer at all. Under `node-linker=isolated` that import has
nothing to resolve inside daisyui's own directory, so TypeScript walks
up into pnpm's hidden hoist directory (`node_modules/.pnpm/
node_modules/`) and takes whichever `tailwindcss` pnpm happened to
hoist there. That is a resolution by accident, and it flipped: while
two workspace packages were on Tailwind 3 the hoist was 3.4.19 and
`frontends/apps/dashboard/tailwind.config.ts` type-checked; the moment
Lane B moved `@vpay/checkout` to Tailwind 4 the hoist became 4.3.3 and
that file failed with `Type 'PluginWithConfig' is not assignable to
type 'PluginCreator | ...'` — daisyUI 4's plugin typed against Tailwind
4's PluginAPI, checked against Tailwind 3's Config. Measured, in ONE
worktree with only the commit changing: `pnpm --filter @vpay/dashboard
typecheck` exits 0 at 08d9b8e and 2 at c105884.
This entry declares the peer daisyUI 4 always had, so pnpm links the
dashboard's own `tailwindcss@3.4.19` into `daisyui@4.12.24`'s
node_modules and the import resolves to the version its consumer
actually uses — the `.npmrc` policy ('undeclared imports fail loudly
rather than working by accident through hoisting') applied to the one
package that was slipping through it. Nine lines of lockfile.
Remove when `frontends/apps/dashboard` leaves daisyUI 4 (plan
docs/plans/2026-09-07-ui-revamp.md §4.2, Lane D), which deletes the
only `daisyui@4` dependent in the workspace.
